skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply advanced macroeconomic theories to analyze macroeconomic relationships and the overall economy.
Evaluate the impact of macroeconomic events and policy changes on the overall economy.
Develop skills in searching for data, synthesizing secondary materials, and using economic analysis tools.
Conduct independent research, work in teams, and present knowledge through writing and discussing macroeconomic situations in Vietnam and around the world.
Enhance critical thinking skills to analyze macroeconomic issues in Vietnam and globally.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in evaluating macroeconomic programs.
Foster self-learning and research skills to enhance knowledge on macroeconomic issues in practice.
